posts.title: DC’s 2026 Cherry Blossoms Are Done. Here’s How the Season Wrapped Up.
posts.description: DC's cherry blossoms are done for the season — the trees are leafing out now after a short, fast bloom squeezed in by a cold winter and warm spring. Here's how the 2026 season played out, plus photos and what's ahead for 2027.
